title: caltha palustris subsp. renifolia
intro: Caltha palustris subsp. renifolia, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. The plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of inflammation, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Caltha palustris subsp. renifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which may help to reduce swelling and promote the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
